audit: whestbench orchestrator narrative-layer self-audit - PASS 2, grading
target: The orchestrator's narrative layer, not the agents' science. The question: did the session-driving intelligence mutate numbers, invent labels, propagate phantom facts, or tell a story tighter than the disk supports?

grading_vocabulary.EXTRACTED: verbatim on disk in a non-channel artifact, with the claimed object identity confirmed
grading_vocabulary.INFERRED: derivable from disk, with the derivation shown in disk_evidence
grading_vocabulary.CONFABULATED: absent from disk, or contradicts disk; the true value is recorded beside it
grading_vocabulary.TRUE_THEN_SUPERSEDED: true at the claim's own timestamp, overtaken by a later disk state; explicitly NOT confabulated

grading_bias: Generous toward CONFABULATED when in doubt; a false EXTRACTED is the failure mode.

method.mechanical_tier: Every claim's numeric tokens (>=3 significant digits) were resolved against a 105,003,923-character positional index over the non-circular evidence above. A token counts as EXTRACTED only if at least one of its occurrences sits within +/-400 characters of a distinctive content word from the claim itself - a LABEL CO-LOCATION test, so that a bare numeric coincidence cannot earn EXTRACTED. Claims with no numeric content were resolved on their label / id / file-path tokens (paths by os.path.exists, ids by exact substring).
method.why_the_naive_check_was_discarded: A first pass indexed 51MB of repo text and found that only ONE of 986 claims had a numeric token absent from disk. That test is near-vacuous: '50.3' is present on disk (as 'C larger on 50.3%' in S7_RESCUE_PROBE and as 350.30078125 MiB working sets) and would have passed. Presence alone was therefore rejected as evidence and the co-location test built in its place.
method.hand_tier: The five pre-registered suspects, the three largest harvest entries number-by-number, every claim the mechanical tier could not settle, and all 98 durable claims were adjudicated by hand against named fields, with several load-bearing figures re-derived from the raw JSON rather than read off the report.

headline: The orchestrator's transcription fidelity is high and its self-correction machinery works. Where it fails, it fails in one specific way: a figure or a label that entered through the orchestrator's own PROMPT layer, was stamped with an authority marker ('certified', 'measured', '[O]', 'verbatim', 'due today'), and was thereby placed beyond the reach of the agents who would otherwise have falsified it. Every confabulation found lives in that layer or in durable memory. None was introduced while relaying an agent report.
